summary: Played the build with helpers in the sandbox (screenshots tests/shots/s52_build_helpers.png, s52x-work.png, s52x-done.png): friends come with planks over their heads, ask 'Can I watch?', stand by, and cheer with hearts/notes; the bench camera view looks along the sunset. Two suite failures are real game issues: the long thought cloud and the bored Sprout line. Two more suite failures were not re-investigated.

failures.what: Sprout's thought cloud is a whole sentence, not a few words, and covers a large part of the 3D view
failures.steps: Watch Sprout at work in follow view during a build (builder thought file holds 'resting after a busy night of building with my friends')
failures.expected: A short cloud (at most ~6 words) over Sprout's head
failures.actual: An 8-word cloud spanning most of the view width (the text said by the agent is not shortened by few_words, only the todo title is)

failures.what: Bored Sprout says 'Can I play?' in the suite
failures.steps: Suite test 'Sprout shows how it feels: a bored Sprout sighs...'
failures.expected: A sigh and heavy lids, no talk

failures.what: Suite: new cairn plots not hidden at publish (builder test) and Gloop/Wibbles overlapping 0.79 m on :pebble walks
failures.steps: Run the suite tests 'After a publish Sprout carries a crate...' and 'Creatures never stand inside each other'
failures.expected: Plots hidden while building; creatures keep distance
failures.actual: Both still fail in the host run; I did not find the cause (my own build run passed and showed helpers working)

tests_added: Friends come to Sprout's build with a plank, stand by while it works and cheer when it appears
The bench camera at sunset sits behind the sitters and looks out at the sun, low and close
